audit.why: Both layers already read Wukong, Wukong, Skill, Wukong, Gwen, Gwen, Gwen, which is the packet chart row for row, and the whys agree with it. Win rate 47.5% over 160 games fits an early-Wukong, late-Gwen shape.
audit.corrected: No chart change needed — the one page in this slice where full and content already agreed with the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes never quote a cooldown, so 'fight when her W is down' has no timer. Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, Snip Snip! is 6.5s at rank 1, Skip 'n Slash 13s at rank 1 with a partial refund on hit, Needlework 120/100/80s.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist's 22s at rank 1 is the entire lane: it is the only long cooldown Gwen owns before 6, and every commit window in this matchup sits inside it.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0] and the ability-interactions box.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is absent and a wrong one is in its place. The page says Hallowed Mist 'nullifies your R Cyclone lock-on' twice. Cyclone is not a lock-on. What Hallowed Mist actually breaks is Nimbus Strike: it is a TARGETED dash, and Riot's W text says Gwen 'can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist' — so from outside the cloud your engage button simply does not cast.
audit.why: Riot W text verbatim: 'Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' The gwen__wukong mirror records exactly this: 'Nimbus Strike being a targeted dash is what makes Hallowed Mist a hard counter to Wukong's opener rather than just a dodge, and it was absent from both layers.'
audit.corrected: Hallowed Mist blocks targeting from outside, so Nimbus Strike cannot dash onto her while she stands in it. Separately, Snip Snip!'s centre deals TRUE damage, which ignores Stone Skin's armour rather than being 'shredded through'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabricated mechanics. (1) 'Needlework (R) gives her long-range poke and reset dashes' — Needlework grants no dash of any kind; it is up to three needle casts that slow and apply her passive. (2) 'Snip Snip's on-hit true damage' — Snip Snip! is a cone ability, not an on-hit effect; her on-hit magic damage comes from Skip 'n Slash (E). (3) 'passive stacks' / 'Stack passive on minions to ramp' — A Thousand Cuts has no stacking mechanic in Riot's text; it is bonus magic damage scaled to the target's health, with healing off champions.
audit.why: Riot R text: 'Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit... This ability can be cast up to two more times.' Riot E text: 'gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit'. Riot P text: 'Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.'
audit.corrected: Needlework is three long-range slowing casts that apply A Thousand Cuts; the on-hit is Skip 'n Slash; the passive scales with your health, not with stacks she banks on minions.

audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her off champion damage, and the itemization line already calls for Executioner's Calling early. That matches the kit's heal flag.

notes: The packet's suspectNames flags 'Snip Snip' and 'Snip Snip's' — correct catch, the real name carries an exclamation mark ('Snip Snip!'), fixed where those strings were rewritten. The bigger finding is the one the mirror already paid for: Hallowed Mist does not merely 'protect' Gwen, it prevents her being TARGETED from outside, and Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash — so your engage button does not cast at all. The page instead claimed twice that the mist beats 'your R Cyclone lock-on', which is not a thing. I also removed three inventions: Needlework granting 'reset dashes', Snip Snip! being an on-hit effect (that is Skip 'n Slash), and A Thousand Cuts having stacks she banks on minions. Riot's passive text describes health-scaled bonus magic damage with healing, no stacks.
